test_framework: No test suite in the repository
build_command: python -c 'import ast; import sys; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in sys.argv[1:]]' fastai/*.py
test_command: python -c 'import ast; import sys; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in sys.argv[1:]]' fastai/*.py
verification_instructions: Parse all .py files in fastai/ with Python AST to confirm no syntax errors were introduced
setup_instructions: No environment setup needed - using AST validation only since dependencies (PyTorch, etc) are not installable in this environment
environment_constraints: Cannot install PyTorch and other heavy dependencies - use AST-based validation to confirm code remains syntactically correct
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md present. Standard practices: do not remove public API that external users might call.
key_patterns: Files use star imports (from .imports import *), modules reference each other heavily. The package is in fastai/fastai/.
directory_structure: fastai/ is the main package source. courses/ and tutorials/ are separate. models/ contains pre-trained model definitions.
